0.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS2V43_00494_GOODLOOKINGMEMBER_000_070
0.description: Back from the roiling seas so soon? And where is the rest of your jolly fellowship?

1.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS2V43_00494_GOODLOOKINGMEMBER_000_080
1.description: Ba'Gamnan transformed, you say? Are you certain it was not some manner of stagecraft? With a dab of mummer's paint, and a few carefully placed lanterns, even the Majestic's meekest have been made to look like monsters, you know.

2.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS2V43_00494_GOODLOOKINGMEMBER_000_090
2.description: Off to heed the call of adventure once again, are we? I won't say I envy you until I hear a full account of the unspeakable horrors you faced...or lack thereof.

3.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS2V43_00494_GOODLOOKINGMEMBER_000_100
3.description: Our sharp-toothed guests? Why, they took their leave some while ago.

4.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS2V43_00494_GOODLOOKINGMEMBER_000_101
4.description: If the mood was sour upon their arrival, you can imagine how it turned upon hearing of their captain's death. Not a single arm clasped nor farewell uttered. One moment they were here, the next, they were not.

5.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS2V43_00494_GOODLOOKINGMEMBER_000_102
5.description: Though, considering the circumstances─you being the one who did the grisly deed, and all─I will gladly take a silent departure over the alternative.

6.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS2V43_00494_GOODLOOKINGMEMBER_000_103
6.description: Oh, not that you had any choice, mind you. Just...do not be surprised if Bwagi and the others see things a little...differently.

7.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS2V43_00494_GARLEANSMEMBER_000_070
7.description: Lighthouse? Truth to tell, it looks more like a futile attempt to harry the heavens than a warning for wayward sailors.

8.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS2V43_00494_GARLEANSMEMBER_000_080
8.description: If the auracite was created to serve as a weapon, then that is all the more reason it belongs in the hands of those who are versed in the rules of engagement─namely, the Garlean Legion.

9.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS2V43_00494_GARLEANSMEMBER_000_090
9.description: These fanciful claims about Garlemald having its roots in Goug─might you have more than mere hearsay to support them? I thought not.

10.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS2V43_00494_GARLEANSMEMBER_000_100
10.description: Very well, I shall entertain the principal's notion that we Garleans are partially descended from the displaced inhabitants of that accursed island. It <hex:021A020203>would<hex:021A020103> explain how the Ivalician legend came to Ilsabard, whence our people's knowledge of automata originated, and even why we lack the knack for manipulating aether...

11.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS2V43_00494_GARLEANSMEMBER_000_101
11.description: ...But it would <hex:021A020203>also<hex:021A020103> make Ivalice our ancestral home, and the Empire all the more justified in reclaiming it.

12.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS2V43_00494_GARLEANSMEMBER_000_102
12.description: This is no conquest. This is no invasion. It is a homecoming. A return to Ivalice.

13.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS2V43_00494_PRETTYMEMBER_000_070
13.description: Welcome back, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Wait... Why are you back again?

14.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS2V43_00494_PRETTYMEMBER_000_080
14.description: Ba'Gamnan dead, his soul lost to the forces of darkness? How tragic! And who exactly was this Ba'Gamnan again?

15.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS2V43_00494_PRETTYMEMBER_000_090
15.description: Garleans descended from the mysterious inhabitants of a legendary clockwork city? That sounds like it has the makings of a marvelous tale! Now, if there were only some place to tell it...

16.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS2V43_00494_PRETTYMEMBER_000_100
16.description: Since our last chat, I have been thinking. The Garlean Republic─now the Garlean Empire─was originally established by seven tribes, one of which now appears to have been the remnants of a people who, thousands of summers past, migrated from a city thought only to be a legend.

17.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS2V43_00494_PRETTYMEMBER_000_101
17.description: But if we Garleans descended from Gougans, who did the Gougans descend from? And who did those people descend from? And those people? If you go back far enough, do we arrive at a single tribe? A single person?

18.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS2V43_00494_PRETTYMEMBER_000_102
18.description: They say this world will never be free of strife, but is that merely because we have lost sight of who we are and whence we came? Would you raise your sword to another if you knew he was your own flesh and blood?

19.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS2V43_00494_BEWITCHINGMEMBER_000_070
19.description: Oh? I did not expect to see you return so soon. Where might the others be?

20.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS2V43_00494_BEWITCHINGMEMBER_000_080
20.description: I sense much danger ahead. Do not allow your desire for adventure to cloud the sound judgment that has seen you this far.

21.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS2V43_00494_BEWITCHINGMEMBER_000_090
21.description: I am delighted you made it back...and in one piece! You must promise to come and see me later, and tell me all that happened. My husband, too.

22.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS2V43_00494_BEWITCHINGMEMBER_000_110
22.description: There was a time, early in my career, when I fancied the principal...but alas he only had eyes for another─my dearest friend and confidant, Tia.

23.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS2V43_00494_BEWITCHINGMEMBER_000_111
23.description: Though my heart ached, I could not let jealousy ruin everything I had worked so hard for, so I gave the pair my blessing and locked my feelings away for all time...or so I thought. But then Tia passed. Tia passed and...

24.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS2V43_00494_BEWITCHINGMEMBER_000_112
24.description: ...I was torn. I longed to console Jenomis in his time of grief, but I was afraid that I would somehow be betraying my friend in so doing─afraid of what my heart might see me do. If it were not for yon dramaturge, I would surely have done something I would have lived to regret. He is my reason for being. The reason I am here.

25.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS2V43_00494_BEWITCHINGMEMBER_000_113
25.description: Oh, dear... I fear that may have been the wine talking. Perhaps I should have another loaf of bacon bread.

26.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS2V43_00494_BEWITCHINGMEMBER_000_200
26.description: Why, hello there! Are those the engines I hear? I do hope we are bound somewhere exciting.

27.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS2V43_00494_BEWITCHINGMEMBER_000_250
27.description: The Viera possess a beauty that cannot be matched by other races. Yet how they stalk the jungle in those stilettos, perhaps we will never know.

28.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS2V43_00494_BEWITCHINGMEMBER_000_280
28.description: From both the principal and my husband I've heard mention of a “blight” brought about by the auracite. Could that portal we just witnessed be a means of spreading it?

29.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS2V43_00494_BEWITCHINGMEMBER_000_281
29.description: No... Now is not the time for idle speculation. You must focus your efforts on the task at hand.

30.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS2V43_00494_BEWITCHINGMEMBER_000_290
30.description: You rescued Alma only to watch as Ramza was taken in her stead? Promise me, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Promise me you will see this right!

31.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS2V43_00494_BEWITCHINGMEMBER_000_300
31.description: We must do something, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Anything! We cannot let it end like this. Tia would never forgive us...

32.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS2V43_00494_BEWITCHINGMEMBER_000_310
32.description: Our thanks, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. If aught ill had befallen Ramza, his mother would have risen from the Lifestream to haunt us for all eternity. Oh, you presume I jest?

33.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS2V43_00494_BEWITCHINGMEMBER_000_320
33.description: "Lord Dycedarg and the duke would use her as a pawn in their game of thrones! Just as the two of them now use you! Is a man like you not ashamed to be no more than a piece in their game? Have you no pride―no honor?“

34.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS2V43_00494_BEWITCHINGMEMBER_000_321
34.description: Hmmm... There is something lacking in the delivery. A touch more tempered fury, perhaps. A sidelong glance into a swift turn and then─ Ah, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Simply practicing my lines.

35.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS2V43_00494_MUSCULARMEMBER_000_070
35.description: A most beautiful construct, this lighthouse before us─its chiseled contours not unlike those of a heaving, oiled chest.

36.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS2V43_00494_MUSCULARMEMBER_000_080
36.description: And you say his muscles swelled to bursting, like firm melons ripening in the summer sun!? Just the thought makes me want to─! No, I must train harder. Harder!

37.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS2V43_00494_MUSCULARMEMBER_000_090
37.description: What's this? You say the expedition might have use for a man of my build? Ah, but you must understand, my friend. If aught were to blemish this flawless frame, all my work would be for naught!

39.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS2V43_00494_MUSCULARMEMBER_000_101
39.description: Long have I trained that I might bring to the stage a vision of unadorned masculinity. Yet, when granted an opportunity to step out onto the greatest stage of all─to join you on your noble expedition─I dart for the shadows like a terror-stricken titmouse!

40.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS2V43_00494_MUSCULARMEMBER_000_102
40.description: Is there aught I might do to cleanse my soul of this shame!?

41.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS2V43_00494_MUSCULARMEMBER_000_103
41.description: I know! I shall train! Harder! Better! Faster! Stronger!

42.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS2V43_00494_PERFORMANCEMEMBER_000_070
42.description: Tell me you did not abandon those poor children on that godsforsaken island!

43.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS2V43_00494_PERFORMANCEMEMBER_000_080
43.description: I doubt there is much hope for Ba'Gamnan now...seeing as─by your own account─he is technically dead. Just don't let the other Bangaa know I said that. They seem ready to explode as it is.

44.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS2V43_00494_PERFORMANCEMEMBER_000_090
44.description: Leaving so soon? I would sing you a lay to send you on your way, but I shall save it for the moment of your return. Whether it be light-hearted or somber is solely up to you.

45.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS2V43_00494_PERFORMANCEMEMBER_000_100
45.description: Rumor has it that you are acquainted with a certain wandering minstrel who just so happens to be visiting Kugane. Now, I am not asking that you introduce me to the man, but I would be forever grateful if you could...well, introduce me to the man.

46.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS2V43_00494_PERFORMANCEMEMBER_000_101
46.description: His tales are like towering pyres, each word a spark that ignites a fire in my very soul. What I would not give to set his verses to music.

47.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS2V43_00494_PERFORMANCEMEMBER_000_102
47.description: Since our arrival over Kugane, Principal Jenomis has stressed the importance of actively studying the culture and seeking aspects that might be applied to our performances. It's just that...leaving the safety of the <hex:021A020203>Prima Vista<hex:021A020103> is not as easy as it seems. Not that I would expect you to understand. You are a <hex:02080FE905FF06776F6D616EFF046D616E03> of the world.

48.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS2V43_00494_DANCINGMEMBER_000_070
48.description: One, two, three! One, two, three!<hex:02100103>It is only through self-reflection that one can truly grow. Yet something tells me now is not the time for that, what with the children waiting down on the island and all.

49.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS2V43_00494_DANCINGMEMBER_000_080
49.description: Onetwothree! Onetwothree! Onetwothree! Onetwo─<hex:02100103>Your tale of Ba'Gamnan has set my heart aflutter! I must calm myself and focus if I am to master this step.

50.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS2V43_00494_DANCINGMEMBER_000_090
50.description: One, two, three! One, two, three!<hex:02100103>How is it that in the face of danger you find the courage to stand firm? I can barely take the stage without losing my supper. Wait, don't tell me─<hex:021A020203>show me<hex:021A020103>!

51.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS2V43_00494_DANCINGMEMBER_000_100
51.description: One, two, three! One, two, three!<hex:02100103>Ah, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Might I ask of you your advice?

52.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS2V43_00494_DANCINGMEMBER_000_101
52.description: Curiosity finally got the better of me and I descended into Kugane to study the dance of the geiko. It was while I was taking a cup of tea that a young man approached me.

53.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS2V43_00494_DANCINGMEMBER_000_102
53.description: He claimed that he had never before seen someone so beautiful and asked if I would give him a linkpearl.

54.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS2V43_00494_DANCINGMEMBER_000_103
54.description: As an actress, I learned early in my career how to deal with insistent admirers...but this seemed different somehow. Still, I was not about to take any chances, so I bid him a polite farewell and returned to the <hex:021A020203>Prima Vista<hex:021A020103>.

55.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS2V43_00494_DANCINGMEMBER_000_104
55.description: Yet now the shuttle pilot tells me the man comes to the docks every morning on the off chance that I might descend once again into the city.

56.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS2V43_00494_DANCINGMEMBER_000_105
56.description: What am I to do, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>? Is he the same as all the rest? Or might his intentions be noble? Agh! All this fretting is wreaking havoc with my routine!

57.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS2V43_00494_YOUNGMANOFLOVE_000_100
57.description: You wouldn't happen to be here visiting the imperial airship docked above, would you?

58.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS2V43_00494_YOUNGMANOFLOVE_000_101
58.description: You would? Then...do you perchance know of a young woman─a dancer─who works on the vessel? I spoke with her once while she was touring the city, but she has kept to the clouds ever since.

59.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS2V43_00494_YOUNGMANOFLOVE_000_102
59.description: Try as I might, I cannot forget her face...her voice...her everything. They haunt me each night as I take my rest...not that I am afforded much rest...

60.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS2V43_00494_YOUNGMANOFLOVE_000_103
60.description: My family claims I have lost my mind─that a Garlean makes for an ill match. But I know in my heart they are wrong. Love knows no boundaries, would you not agree? And so I wait. And I shall go on waiting─forever, if I must.

61.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS2V43_00494_YOUNGMANOFLOVE_000_150
61.description: With every moment that passes, my love for her doth grow more fierce. Oh, gods, why must you torment me so!?

62.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS2V43_00494_YOUNGMANOFLOVE_000_200
62.description: ...Would you marry─ No...  Might you consider having me for your─ No, no... I believe I would make a fine father to our─ Oh, most definitely no. What am I thinking!?

63.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS2V43_00494_YOUNGMANOFLOVE_000_201
63.description: Ah, I was...er...reciting my lines for a...a new play. Yes, that is all. Would you...er...allow a man some privacy?

64.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS2V43_00494_YOUNGMANOFLOVE_000_250
64.description: I cannot bear it any longer! If I do not see her soon, my heart will shatter into a thousand thousand pieces!

65.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS2V43_00494_YOUNGMANOFLOVE_000_251
65.description: M-My lines, of course! I come here to practice them...obviously. Now, if you don't mind─some privacy, <hex:020813E905FF076D696C616479FF076D696C6F726403>.

66.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS2V43_00494_YOUNGMANOFLOVE_000_280
66.description: You, ah...wouldn't happen to know what has transpired on the airship, would you? It is something terrible, isn't it? None have descended to the city in days...
